changelog: Delivered cars now auto-remove from Inventory 5 days after delivery (same as pressing Delete — car + Storage photos are gone). Before that happens, a data-only record (stock#, VIN, price, buyer name/phone, sold/delivered dates — no photos) is logged to a local sales archive kept for ~1 year, in case a dispute or fraud question comes up later. Added Buyer Name/Phone fields to the Edit Vehicle page so that info gets captured before the car is archived. Runs automatically on app load + hourly while the app is open.
